selected_script.angle: Streamline laundry day in tight spaces by replacing oversized, tipping clothing lines with a stable, multi-level vertical folding rack
selected_script.hook: Tired of your wet clothes tipping over cheap, flimsy plastic hangers? Try this instead.

timeline.scene: Show a real-life wrong behavior where a person struggles to drape wet laundry over a dining chair, causing the chair to look messy and the wet fabric to slide off.
Instantly transition to the solution: the solid matte white accordion laundry rack is expanded beside a front-loading washing machine, and clothes are hung neatly over its top rails.
Fast-cut scene showing a close-up of a towel being smoothly laid flat on the top parallel platform.
Fast-cut scene showing a side angle of several dark pants and light towels hanging naturally over separate horizontal rails of the expanded white rack.
Fast-cut scene showing a close-up of hands easily collapsing the rack flat into its compact scissor form and leaning it upright against a plain laundry room wall.
Light CTA overlay text: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in a realistic handheld phone-shot style. The video must feature the exact product shown in the reference image: a solid matte white free-standing folding laundry rack with two matching white accordion scissor side frames, a flat top platform with parallel white rods, and lower horizontal drying rails on splayed legs, with no wheels. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life wrong behavior where a person struggles to drape wet laundry over a dining chair, causing the chair to look messy and the wet fabric to slide off. 3-6s: Transition to the solution: the clean white accordion laundry rack is expanded beside a front-loading washing machine, and wet clothes are hung neatly over its top rails. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene showing a close-up of a towel being smoothly laid flat on the top platform. No CTA in this segment.
